883-2228-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
883-2228-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
883-2228-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1283-1651-4365-4772-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season and Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-4365-4772-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1477-4574-6900--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
1477-4574-6900--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

3099-3755-3995.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3099-3755-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3755-3995.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2762-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

654-4772-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-6970-7296-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1895-2146-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1792-4404-6747.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control an artifact.
457-1792-4404-6747.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Sami.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2506-2557-4600-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

109-232-813-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3490-4050-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-6752.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2167-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2167-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing the Mutavault token, adding {C}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

413-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1414-1477-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

252-5394-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1117-3689-6518-6747.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with one to three time counters on it

1618-2092-2364-2806.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying at most {1}, removing three time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, and then exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

1358-2073-4659-5115--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1977-2557-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1977-2557-4499.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

880-1659-2653.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1003-5220-5683-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

372-1809-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1069-3552-4359-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4359-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

337-1680-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real and Runed Stalactite attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-1680-4222-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

1430-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1430-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-2854-3921-4770.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-3921-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

864-1409-3518.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Eternal Witness.
864-1409-3518.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond, sacrificing it to add {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Eternal Witness's soulbond ability, exiling it and then returning it to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness triggers on ETB, returning Lion's Eye Diamond to your hand.
Deadeye Navigator triggers, pairing itself with Eternal Witness.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Once you have infinite blue mana, repeat for infinite colored mana and graveyard recursion.
